breakdown.description: Requesting twoPhaseEulerFoam solver but the case setup is configured for multiphaseEulerFoam with different phase configuration and interaction models
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains 'twoPhaseEulerFoam' as the solver (mentioned both at the beginning and end of the specification), whereas the ground truth requires 'multiphaseEulerFoam'. The agent failed to identify and correct this inconsistency, despite the case setup (blending schemes, multiple dispersed/segregated configurations, reference phase) being characteristic of multiphaseEulerFoam.
